key.remorphed_menu: Open menu to choose second shape
remorphed.help.welcome: Welcome to Morphing Time! Kill mobs to unlock them, then morph into them.
remorphed.help.variants_description: Select a custom variant by opening the variants menu with '%s'. You can cycle through variants by scrolling with your mouse wheel. Confirm the variant by pressing '%s' again.
remorphed.help.support_label: Experiencing an issue or want to post suggestions?
remorphed.help.ability_description_1: To use a mob's ability, press '%s'.
remorphed.help.ability_description_2: A cooldown indicator will appear in the bottom-right of the screen to show you when the ability can be used again.
remorphed.help.ability_description_3: The README at https://github.com/magicbanana666/MorphingTime lists which mobs have abilities.
remorphed.help.config_description: The settings are in the config/morphingtime folder: unlocking.json5 and morphing.json5.
remorphed.help.deleting_shapes_descripti: There are two ways for a player to delete their shapes within the morph menu: They can press 'X' on their keyboard or the third mouse button (press the scroll wheel). It will remove one point from the shape.
remorphed.help.return: Press any key to close this menu.
remorphed.permission.morph.denied: You don't have permission to morph.
remorphed.permission.entity.denied: You don't have permission to morph into this entity type.
remorphed.permission.command.denied: You don't have permission to use this command.
remorphed.legend.tooltip: What do the icons on the cards mean?
remorphed.legend.title: Icon Legend
remorphed.legend.favorite.desc: Right-click a card to mark it as a favorite. Favorites are listed first.
remorphed.legend.current.desc: The green outline shows the morph you are now.
remorphed.legend.uses.desc: How many more times you can morph into this mob, if the server limits it. Kill more of them to get more.
remorphed.legend.used_up.desc: You have no morphs left for this mob. Kill another one to use it again.
remorphed.card.hint: Click to morph, right-click to favorite
remorphed.menu.empty_hint: Kill a mob to add it to your collection.
